bk.ready.text: Hi, head baker! The festival order is waiting. Ready to bake?
bk.ready.speaker: bobbo

bk.back.text: Welcome back, head baker. More orders came in!
bk.back.speaker: bobbo

bk.story.intro1.text: Tomorrow is the island festival, and Bobbo's Bakery just got its biggest order ever.

bk.story.intro2.text: Cookies, muffins, cakes and pies for the whole island! That's too much for one baker.
bk.story.intro2.speaker: bobbo

bk.story.intro3.text: Puff knows a baker's secret: bake in neat rows, cut fair slices, and draw the order before you start.

bk.story.intro4.text: Will you be my head baker? Here's your hat!
bk.story.intro4.speaker: bobbo

bk.story.between2.text: The first trays are in the oven. It smells wonderful!
bk.story.between2.speaker: bobbo

bk.story.between4.text: Halfway there. The festival cart is waiting by the door.

bk.story.between6.text: Nearly done! Let's check the order sheet next.
bk.story.between6.speaker: bobbo

bk.story.outro1.text: Every tray is full and every line of the order is ticked.

bk.story.outro2.text: You planned each batch step by step. Thank you, head baker!
bk.story.outro2.speaker: bobbo

bk.story.outro3.text: The festival cart rolls out. Here's your Head Baker's Hat sticker!

bk.prompt.tutorial.text: Tap plus to add a row. Make two rows of three cookies.
bk.prompt.tutorial.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.count.text: How many cookies are on this tray? Count in rows.
bk.prompt.count.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.build.text: Fill the tray with the rows the order asks for.
bk.prompt.build.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.fact.text: How many cookies fill this big tray?
bk.prompt.fact.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.missing.rows.text: Share the cookies into equal rows. How many go in each row?
bk.prompt.missing.rows.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.missing.size.text: Each row holds the same number. How many rows do we need?
bk.prompt.missing.size.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.area.text: How many square tiles cover this tray?
bk.prompt.area.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.perim.text: How much ribbon goes all the way round this tray?
bk.prompt.perim.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.make.text: Make a tray with the right area. How high does it need to be?
bk.prompt.make.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.lshape.text: This tray is shaped like an L. How many square tiles cover it?
bk.prompt.lshape.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.of.text: Some of the muffins get icing. How many is that?
bk.prompt.of.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.equiv.text: Ice the same amount of the second cake.
bk.prompt.equiv.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.cmp.text: Which is more cake? Or are they the same?
bk.prompt.cmp.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.bar.text: Read the order. Put each number on its bar, then work it out.
bk.prompt.bar.speaker: bobbo

bk.prompt.order.text: Festival order! Work out each line, then the total for the cart.
bk.prompt.order.speaker: bobbo

bk.help.count.text: Count one row, then count the rows. Rows times how many in each row gives the total.
bk.help.count.speaker: puff

bk.help.build.text: Rows go across, like shelves. Set the rows first, then how many cookies sit in each row.
bk.help.build.speaker: puff

bk.help.missing.text: Think multiplication backwards: what times the number you know makes the total?
bk.help.missing.speaker: puff

bk.help.area.text: Area is the tiles inside. Count the tiles in one row, then multiply by the number of rows.
bk.help.area.speaker: puff

bk.help.perim.text: Perimeter is the ribbon round the outside. Add up all four sides.
bk.help.perim.speaker: puff

bk.help.make.text: Width times height makes the area. What height, times the width, gives the tiles we need?
bk.help.make.speaker: puff

bk.help.lshape.text: Cut the L into two rectangles. Find each area, then add them together.
bk.help.lshape.speaker: puff

bk.help.of.text: The bottom number says how many equal groups. The top number says how many groups to take.
bk.help.of.speaker: puff

bk.help.equiv.text: Same cake, smaller slices. Ice exactly as much cake, even if it takes more slices.
bk.help.equiv.speaker: puff

bk.help.cmp.text: Both cakes are the same size. Look at how big each slice is and how many slices there are.
bk.help.cmp.speaker: puff

bk.help.bar.text: Draw the story first. Match each number to its part of the bar, then find the missing part.
bk.help.bar.speaker: puff

bk.help.cmpb.text: Two bars to compare. The longer bar is the shorter one plus the extra. Then put them together.
bk.help.cmpb.speaker: puff

bk.help.mulb.text: Equal pieces for the trays, plus a little piece for the extras. Multiply first, then add.
bk.help.mulb.speaker: puff

bk.help.timesb.text: Times as many means the same bar, repeated. Count how many copies you need.
bk.help.timesb.speaker: puff

bk.help.fracb.text: Cut the bar into equal parts. Find one part, then the cinnamon parts, then what is left.
bk.help.fracb.speaker: puff

bk.help.order.text: One line at a time. Work out each line, then add all the lines for the cart.
bk.help.order.speaker: puff

bk.hint.added.text: Looks like those numbers were added. Rows of cookies are equal groups, so we multiply.
bk.hint.added.speaker: puff

bk.hint.oneRow.text: That's just one row. Now count how many rows there are.
bk.hint.oneRow.speaker: puff

bk.hint.oneCol.text: That's the number of rows. How many cookies are in each one?
bk.hint.oneCol.speaker: puff

bk.hint.rowOff.text: So close! Count the rows again, one finger on each row.
bk.hint.rowOff.speaker: puff

bk.hint.swap.text: Right cookies, turned sideways! Rows go across, like shelves.
bk.hint.swap.speaker: puff

bk.hint.sameTotal.text: That's the right number of cookies, but check the rows the order asks for.
bk.hint.sameTotal.speaker: puff

bk.hint.rowsOff.text: Each row looks right. Now count the rows.
bk.hint.rowsOff.speaker: puff

bk.hint.colsOff.text: The rows look right. Now check how many sit in each row.
bk.hint.colsOff.speaker: puff

bk.hint.neighbour.text: One row or one column away! Split the tray into facts you know and add them.
bk.hint.neighbour.speaker: puff

bk.hint.subtracted.text: Taking away won't share them out. Which number times the one you know makes the total?
bk.hint.subtracted.speaker: puff

bk.hint.addedDiv.text: Adding makes more cookies, not equal rows. Try multiplication backwards.
bk.hint.addedDiv.speaker: puff

bk.hint.multiplied.text: That's far more cookies than we have! We are sharing them out, so think: what times this number?
bk.hint.multiplied.speaker: puff

bk.hint.offByOne.text: Nearly! Check it: multiply your answer by the number you know.
bk.hint.offByOne.speaker: puff

bk.hint.perimeter.text: That's the ribbon round the edge. Area means the tiles inside.
bk.hint.perimeter.speaker: puff

bk.hint.addedSides.text: Adding two sides gives a length. Area is rows of tiles, so multiply.
bk.hint.addedSides.speaker: puff

bk.hint.edgeTiles.text: Those are just the tiles along the edge. Count the middle ones too.
bk.hint.edgeTiles.speaker: puff

bk.hint.area.text: That's the tiles inside. Perimeter is the ribbon round the outside edge.
bk.hint.area.speaker: puff

bk.hint.half.text: That's only two sides. The ribbon goes all the way round: four sides.
bk.hint.half.speaker: puff

bk.hint.edgeSquares.text: Careful at the corners! Count the edge lengths, not the squares beside them.
bk.hint.edgeSquares.speaker: puff

bk.hint.threeSides.text: One side is missing. Walk your finger all the way round.
bk.hint.threeSides.speaker: puff

bk.hint.box.text: That counts the corner that was cut out. Take away the missing piece, or split the L.
bk.hint.box.speaker: puff

bk.hint.onePart.text: That's one rectangle. Find the other one and add them together.
bk.hint.onePart.speaker: puff

bk.hint.addedNotch.text: The cut-out corner has no tiles. Take it away instead of adding it.
bk.hint.addedNotch.speaker: puff

bk.hint.byNum.text: Split by the bottom number. It tells how many equal groups to make.
bk.hint.byNum.speaker: puff

bk.hint.noDivide.text: That's more muffins than we have! First split them into equal groups.
bk.hint.noDivide.speaker: puff

bk.hint.rest.text: That's the muffins with no icing. How many get icing?
bk.hint.rest.speaker: puff

bk.hint.subNum.text: Fractions split things into equal groups. Taking away won't do that.
bk.hint.subNum.speaker: puff

bk.hint.sameTop.text: Those slices are smaller, so the same number of slices is less cake. Ice more of them.
bk.hint.sameTop.speaker: puff

bk.hint.addSame.text: Adding the same to top and bottom changes the amount. Each slice is cut into equal pieces instead.
bk.hint.addSame.speaker: puff

bk.hint.cmp.bigDen.text: More slices means smaller slices. With the same number of slices, which slices are bigger?
bk.hint.cmp.bigDen.speaker: puff

bk.hint.cmp.smallNum.text: The slices are the same size here. So more slices means more cake.
bk.hint.cmp.smallNum.speaker: puff

bk.hint.cmp.notSame.text: Look closely at the iced parts. Is one a little bigger?
bk.hint.cmp.notSame.speaker: puff

bk.hint.cmp.isSame.text: Look again. Cut into more slices, but is it really more cake?
bk.hint.cmp.isSame.speaker: puff

bk.hint.cmp.half.text: Compare each one with half a cake. Which is more than half?
bk.hint.cmp.half.speaker: puff

bk.hint.oneStep.text: That's one step done. Read the question again: what else does it ask?
bk.hint.oneStep.speaker: puff

bk.hint.sold.text: That's how many were sold. The question asks how many are left.
bk.hint.sold.speaker: puff

bk.hint.forgotMore.text: Bobbo's bar is longer. Don't forget his extra piece.
bk.hint.forgotMore.speaker: puff

bk.hint.moreTwice.text: The extra piece belongs to one bar only. Add it just once.
bk.hint.moreTwice.speaker: puff

bk.hint.oneStepPuff.text: That's how many Puff baked. Now put both bars together.
bk.hint.oneStepPuff.speaker: puff

bk.hint.whoHasMore.text: Who baked more? Bobbo did, so Puff's bar is the shorter one.
bk.hint.whoHasMore.speaker: puff

bk.hint.addedGroups.text: Each tray is a whole group. Multiply the trays first, then add the extras.
bk.hint.addedGroups.speaker: puff

bk.hint.forgotExtra.text: The trays are done. Don't forget the little extra piece!
bk.hint.forgotExtra.speaker: puff

bk.hint.extraEach.text: The extras come once, not on every tray. Add them at the end.
bk.hint.extraEach.speaker: puff

bk.hint.wrongGroups.text: Check which number is one tray and which is how many trays.
bk.hint.wrongGroups.speaker: puff

bk.hint.oneStepTimes.text: That's Bobbo's bar. The question asks about both bars.
bk.hint.oneStepTimes.speaker: puff

bk.hint.addedTimes.text: Times as many means copies of Puff's bar, not adding a few.
bk.hint.addedTimes.speaker: puff

bk.hint.bobboOnly.text: That's all of Bobbo's. How much longer is his bar than Puff's?
bk.hint.bobboOnly.speaker: puff

bk.hint.total.text: That's both together. The question asks how many more.
bk.hint.total.speaker: puff

bk.hint.part.text: That's the cinnamon part. The question asks about the rest.
bk.hint.part.speaker: puff

bk.hint.lineTray.text: Check the cookies line. Rows of cookies means multiply.
bk.hint.lineTray.speaker: puff

bk.hint.lineBoxes.text: Check the boxes or bags line. Equal boxes means multiply.
bk.hint.lineBoxes.speaker: puff

bk.hint.lineBrownies.text: Check the brownies line. Squares in a slab is an area: rows times columns.
bk.hint.lineBrownies.speaker: puff

bk.hint.lineFrac.text: Check the muffins line. Find one equal group first, then take the groups you need.
bk.hint.lineFrac.speaker: puff

bk.hint.lineExtra.text: Check the buns line. Don't forget the extra buns.
bk.hint.lineExtra.speaker: puff

bk.hint.missedLine.text: Did every line go into the total? Add them all for the cart.
bk.hint.missedLine.speaker: puff

bk.help.factSplit.text: Big trays are easier in two pieces. Cut the tray into facts you know, then add the pieces.
bk.help.factSplit.speaker: puff

bk.help.cmpbPuff.text: Two bars to compare. Bobbo baked more, so Puff's bar is Bobbo's bar without the extra.
bk.help.cmpbPuff.speaker: puff

bk.hint.oneGroup.text: That's one equal group. Now take as many groups as the top number says.
bk.hint.oneGroup.speaker: puff

bk.hint.sameTopBig.text: Those slices are bigger, so fewer of them make the same amount of cake.
bk.hint.sameTopBig.speaker: puff

bk.hint.subSame.text: Taking the same from the top and bottom changes the amount. Put small slices together into big ones.
bk.hint.subSame.speaker: puff

bk.hint.equivRest.text: That's the part of the cake with no icing. How much should be iced?
bk.hint.equivRest.speaker: puff

bk.hint.makePerimeter.text: That height gives that much ribbon round the edge. We need that many tiles inside: width times height.
bk.hint.makePerimeter.speaker: puff

bk.hint.makeSubtracted.text: Taking the width away won't work. Which height, times the width, makes the tiles we need?
bk.hint.makeSubtracted.speaker: puff

bk.hint.fewerPuff.text: Puff baked fewer. Take the extra off Bobbo's number to make Puff's bar.
bk.hint.fewerPuff.speaker: puff

bk.hint.justPuff.text: That's both bakers together. The question asks only about Puff.
bk.hint.justPuff.speaker: puff

bk.hint.wholeParts.text: That's only some of the parts. The whole bar is every part together: both sales and what's left.
bk.hint.wholeParts.speaker: puff

bk.hint.notTakeAway.text: Careful: the word left doesn't always mean take away. Look at the bar: which part is missing?
bk.hint.notTakeAway.speaker: puff

bk.hint.addAllBar.text: Selling takes some away. Which parts come off the whole bar?
bk.hint.addAllBar.speaker: puff

bk.praise.rows.text: You counted in rows. That's the baker's way!
bk.praise.rows.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.rows2.text: Rows times how many in each row. You worked it out!
bk.praise.rows2.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.build.text: You set the rows first, then filled each one. Perfect tray!
bk.praise.build.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.missing.text: You thought multiplication backwards. Equal rows every time!
bk.praise.missing.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.area.text: Rows of tiles, multiplied. You measured the inside!
bk.praise.area.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.perim.text: You went all the way round the edge. The ribbon fits!
bk.praise.perim.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.lshape.text: You split the L into rectangles and added them. Nice plan!
bk.praise.lshape.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.of.text: Equal groups first, then the groups you need. Lovely icing!
bk.praise.of.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.equiv.text: Different slices, the same amount of cake. You checked it carefully!
bk.praise.equiv.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.cmp.text: You looked at the slices, not just the numbers. Good thinking!
bk.praise.cmp.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.bar.text: You drew the story first, then solved it. Order done!
bk.praise.bar.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.bar2.text: Two steps, one at a time. That order is ready!
bk.praise.bar2.speaker: bobbo

bk.praise.order.text: Every line checked and added. The cart is packed!
bk.praise.order.speaker: bobbo

bk.model.text: Here's how a baker works it out. Follow the steps, then press Check.
bk.model.speaker: puff

bk.labels.text: That number belongs on a different bar. Read the story again.
bk.labels.speaker: puff

bk.idle.text: Take your time. Look at the picture, then try an answer.
bk.idle.speaker: bobbo
